title: leucanthemum ircutianum subsp. crassifolium
intro: Leucanthemum ircutianum subsp. crassifolium, commonly known as a variant of the mountain daisy, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum ircutianum subsp. crassifolium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
